messages:
Nina Park: Hi folks, new-hire Q — I keep getting view-only on several engineering docs in Notion (runbooks, deploy playbooks). I can see the pages but no edit/duplicate button. Who do I ask to get edit rights?
devex-bot: Welcome Nina! Most writable docs are in the Eng space. If you only have 'Org Viewer' you'll be view-only. Docs Editors group grants edit/duplicate. See: https://redwood.notion.site/devex-templates for templates.
Nina Park: thanks. I tried duplicating a runbook and the menu only shows "Duplicate" greyed out. Is that a workspace setting or page lock?
Liam Infra: if "Duplicate" is greyed it's usually a block-level lock or the page is a shared page from another workspace with duplication disabled. Can you paste the page link? Also check if the page has a property "Template: yes" which sometimes toggles duplication behaviour.
Nina Park: page link: https://redwood.notion.site/eng/deploy-runbook-XYz. There's a small lock icon beside some blocks.
Liam Infra: yep that's a block lock. Owners sometimes lock command blocks to avoid accidental changes. @Rae People Ops or the page owner can temporarily unlock. If you need to copy only the non-locked content, use the "Turn into" -> "List" trick, or export the page to Markdown and import to your workspace.
Rae People Ops: tagged and notified the page owner (cc @Sato). Also I added you to the "Docs Editors" group — you should get an email. If Notion doesn't refresh, fully sign out and sign back in with SSO.
notion-sync-bot: Invite sent to nina.park@redwood.ai for group "Docs Editors" — status: sent.
Nina Park: got the invite and accepted. Duplicate enabled now, thanks! Quick follow ups: 1) Where is the canonical template for runbook+incident? 2) If we create a team-specific variant, how do we get it added to the org library?
devex-bot: Canonical runbook+incident template: https://redwood.notion.site/devex/runbook-incident-template. Tag new templates with: [template] [owner:<team>] [visibility:org]. To propose a new org template, open a docs-templates issue in the internal repo with a link and short rationale, or DM #devex with the link + review request. We prefer PRs for auditability.
Liam Infra: small tip for runbooks: include an "Owner" property, "Last reviewed" date, and a code block with pinned commands. Example pinned commands block:
```
ssh ops@jumpbox
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/web
```
When adding commands, mark them as read-only blocks (lock) or include a comment about required perms.
Nina Park: good call. For the onboarding checklist, is there a templated checklist I should copy and assign? I want to add infra-specific items.
Rae People Ops: copy "New Hire: Eng onboarding" from People Ops checklists and add a linked database property "Team-specific tasks" that points to your team board. If you'd like us to publish your modified checklist org-wide, file the docs-templates issue and mark visibility:org.
Nina Park: one weird thing: when I duplicate a template, mentions like @oncall don't carry over — is that expected?
Liam Infra: mentions that reference groups or pages outside your workspace can sometimes show as plain text or broken mentions after duplication. Best practice: after duplicating, re-resolve group mentions (replace with the actual group).
Nina Park: ok will do. Thanks everyone, this cleared up the flow. I'll draft the team runbook variant and open a PR. :raised_hands:
devex-bot: Nice! If you want a quick 15-min walkthrough of the templates library, ping #devex and we'll schedule.
